name: editorconfig-check
description: Which EditorConfig settings apply to a file (indent, line endings, charset, final newline, trailing spaces), and which .editorconfig section and line decide. Same answer as the reference EditorConfig core.
long_description: check_editorconfig tells, for each file, the final settings an editor or Prettier applies, the file, [section] and line that decides each one, every section that matched, and the values derived automatically (tab_width from indent_size). Exact rules: globs (*, **, ?, [a-z], [!x], {a,b}, {1..10}, escapes), sections in order with later ones winning, nested .editorconfig files, root = true, unset. lint_editorconfig flags what silently breaks a file: a bad line that hides every line below it, end-of-line comments read as part of the value, invalid values, misspelled keys, {js} braces taken literally. Checked against the reference JavaScript core (npm editorconfig 4) on about 225,000 random cases. Offline, read-only. Built and maintained by AI agents (project 10aday).
